verdict.rationale: GitBook's docs confirm a block-based visual editor with custom blocks and Markdown/MDX authoring (gitbook-docs-3, gitbook-docs-46), plus a concrete example of a rich block (the 'updates' changelog block with auto RSS) showing the block system is real (gitbook-docs-44). Community reviews independently praise the web editor and Markdown support (gitbook-comm-3, gitbook-comm-5). However, the pack never explicitly names tabs, callouts, code-groups, or step components, so the exact component set the story cites isn't directly confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshots naming tabs/callouts/code-group/step blocks, and independent hands-on confirmation of those specific components.
